task: Hide cancelled SCM split lifecycles from PO/TO Schedule, including reused references such as SN1400761
behaviors: Search returns only the active replacement when an unsplit reference is reused; its content and pallet quantity remain correct.
Cancelled splits are absent from global search, completed search, explicit completed filters, exact-reference batches and status projections, including when no replacement exists.
The split ledger status is authoritative even if the retired child header or lines have stale active flags.
Active source POs, active splits, legitimate empty POs, ordinary completed/inactive POs and transfer orders retain existing visibility.
Authenticated schedule HTTP responses contain one active replacement; anonymous requests remain denied.
Reading the schedule leaves purchase orders, item lines, split history and schedule records unchanged.

setup.dependencies: No new dependencies; use existing Node, PostgreSQL, fast-check, c8, ESLint and TypeScript test image.
setup.isolation: Standard disposable Compose stack, mbbs-tests.slice, resource limits, teardown registered before startup; no production data in tests.
setup.git: Preserve unrelated workspace edits; no commits or resets.
setup.artifacts: Regression test, reproducible validation/release scripts, red and final logs, mutation evidence, source manifests and deployment verification.
setup.release: Capture the live runtime and apply only the schedule query change. No migration or business-data repair. App-only restart with rollback image.

failureModel.hide_replacement_by_shared_ref: Assert active internal ID and quantity for reused references and mutate identity matching.
failureModel.hide_completed_history: Keep ordinary completed/inactive purchase and transfer orders visible in explicit history searches.
failureModel.retired_record_reappears: Exercise every include-completed path, stale flags and multiple cancelled lifecycles.
failureModel.data_changed_by_filter: Compare saved records before and after schedule reads.
failureModel.unrelated_release_changes: Source hashes restrict the release to one file; verify production configuration and dependencies.
